name: Residential & High-Rise Moving
tagline: White-glove moving for South Florida's luxury condos, high-rises, and single-family estates.
description: South Florida's premier residential buildings have strict requirements — elevator reservations, loading dock windows, COIs, and floor protection mandates. Our crews are trained for exactly this environment. We handle building compliance paperwork, protect every surface from lobby to unit, and deliver with the precision that Brickell, Aventura, and Sunny Isles properties demand. Whether you're moving from a waterfront penthouse or a Coral Gables estate, the standard never changes.

name: Long-Distance Moving
tagline: Dedicated truck, GPS tracking, one coordinator — from South Florida to anywhere in the country.
description: Long-distance moves demand a level of logistics discipline that most companies don't provide. We assign a dedicated truck to your move — no shared loads, no depot stops — and give you one coordinator from Miami pickup through final delivery. Real-time GPS tracking, daily status updates, and a defined delivery window keep you informed at every stage. We regularly move clients from South Florida to New York, Chicago, Los Angeles, and points beyond.

name: International Moving
tagline: Global relocations handled with the same precision as a local move — from Miami to anywhere.
description: International moves require customs expertise, vetted global freight partners, and documentation that most movers get wrong. Our team manages every element: export permits, customs declarations, destination customs clearance, sea or air freight selection, and final-mile delivery. We regularly relocate South Florida clients to Europe, Latin America, and beyond. You have one contact for the entire process — from your Miami-Dade address to wherever you land.

name: Office & Commercial
tagline: Business moves scheduled around your hours, handled with the same care as residential work.
description: Business moves need to happen around your schedule. We work evenings and weekends to keep your downtime short. Our crews handle office furniture, workstations, monitors, and AV equipment carefully, and we disassemble and reassemble modular furniture on-site. We're a small, focused team — not a large commercial moving company — so we take on office jobs where quality and communication matter more than raw speed. Eugene stays directly involved on every commercial job.
pricingNote:
Pricing based on crew size, scope, and scheduling requirements.
• After-hours and weekend moves available
• Custom quotes for larger or complex projects

name: Fine Art & Specialty Items
tagline: Custom crating, climate-controlled transport, and white-glove installation for irreplaceable pieces.
description: South Florida's art collectors, estate owners, and luxury residents trust us with pieces that have no replacement value. Grand pianos, museum-quality paintings, antique furniture, wine collections, and curated sculptures require specialist handling that goes beyond standard moving. Our trained art handlers use custom crating built to piece dimensions, climate-controlled vehicles, and white-glove installation with gallery-level precision. Every specialty move includes full documentation and photographic inventory.

name: Storage Coordination
tagline: We pick up your items, place them in secure storage, and return them when you're ready.
description: We can pick up your items, place them in a secure storage unit, and return them when needed. This removes the need for you to manage storage yourself. Pricing depends on unit size and duration.
